name: Behind the Kiln
audience: women who want one hobby that makes them put the phone down
promise: You will leave with a mug you made and two hours where nobody needed anything from you.
cta: Book a Thursday wheel night. Link in bio, six seats a week.
stories: The first bowl I ever threw collapsed and I laughed so hard I cried. I kept it.
A student told me Thursday is the only night her phone stays in her bag.
I cracked a whole kiln load in March and opened the studio anyway.
